definitions.gloss: winning a prize, receiving an award
definitions.explanation: The act of being awarded a prize, medal, or other recognition. Commonly used in news about literary awards, Nobel prizes, film festivals, and competitions.

examples.japanese: ノーベル{賞|しょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}した。
{受賞|じゅしょう}の{知|し}らせを{聞|き}いて{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: I was moved to tears when I heard the news of winning the award.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{数々|かずかず}の{映画賞|えいがしょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}した{実力派|じつりょくは}の{女優|じょゆう}だ。
examples.english: She is a talented actress who has won numerous film awards.

notes:
Also functions as a する verb ({受賞|じゅしょう}する). The opposite is {授賞|じゅしょう} (giving/awarding a prize), which is a homophone — context usually makes the distinction clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受賞|じゅしょう}{者|しゃ} — prize winner, award recipient
- {受賞|じゅしょう}{作|さく} — award-winning work
- {受賞|じゅしょう}{歴|れき} — award history
- {受賞|じゅしょう}スピーチ — acceptance speech
- {受賞|じゅしょう}を{祝|いわ}う — to celebrate receiving an award
